findings: F1 (medium, REQ-002/REQ-004 data integrity, ADR-005; pre-existing, NEW): src/lib/seed.ts seedLibraryIfEmpty() decides emptiness with network getDocs(limit 1). Offline or on lie-fi with an empty local cache (fresh PWA install, cleared site data, new device), the real SDK resolves getDocs from the empty cache (fromCache=true, size 0; measured 597 ms refused, ~11 s blackhole in eval-00005) and the function queues a 66-exercise batch. Probe: 66 seed docs queued locally on both refused and blackhole. On reconnect the batch commits into DB marombapp, which now holds the PO's migrated library (ADR-005), creating 66 duplicates. No existing issue covers this (#20 scope excludes seed.ts). Fix: skip seeding when snap.metadata.fromCache is true (or use getDocsFromServer with retry), or write seeds with deterministic IDs (for example a slug of the canonical name) so a re-seed is idempotent. Recommend an eval-finding.

F2 (low, #20 x #21): createExercise/updateExercise/deleteExercise now always resolve (void write.catch(() => {})), so ExerciseFormSheet's localizeFirebaseError save-error UI cannot trigger on a write rejection. tests/unit/firebaseErrorsUi.test.tsx 'localizes Firestore permission-denied and unknown save errors' mocks createExercise rejecting, which production can no longer produce (invariants Rule 4 adjacent). On a real rejection the optimistic entry silently disappears at the next snapshot. Rejections are rare under single-UID rules. Options: surface background write failures (toast via a shared rejection handler) or retire the stale test and the dead UI path.
F3 (info, REQ-006): plans.ts 295, copy-default-to-marombapp.mjs 294 and PlanDetailView.tsx 293 lines are near the 300 limit. sessions.ts went from 292 to 266.
